summary: This is an 8-K filed by Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VI, a SPAC, announcing the separate trading of its Class A ordinary shares and warrants starting May 18, 2026. Each unit consists of one share and one-third of a redeemable warrant. No business combination, acquisition, or special situation is disclosed; the filing merely implements the unit separation as part of standard post-IPO mechanics. Holders may trade units as whole units or separate components. There are no deal terms, premium, board recommendation, or time-sensitive event beyond the effective date of separation.
